name: bugsnap-ai
description: Evidence-aware screenshot to bug report workspace powered by Gemma 4.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n client,server -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w client -- --run && npm run test -w server -- --run
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n client,server -c green,cyan "npm run test:watch -w client" "npm run test:watch -w server"
